hook_text: He herded cattle in the hills as a boy. He spent 27 years in prison. Then he became President.
clip_script: Qunu, Eastern Cape. A boy called Rolihlahla looks after cattle on the green hills. He becomes a lawyer in Johannesburg, and fights against apartheid. In 1964 he is sent to prison for life. Twenty-seven years later, in 1990, he walks out free, and instead of seeking revenge, he works for peace. In 1994, Nelson Mandela becomes South Africa's first democratically elected President. A good leader listens, works with a team, is brave and makes sacrifices.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline winding like a road across hills, with stops: a herd boy, a law office, a prison cell, an open gate, the Union Buildings.
mood: Hopeful and moving, like a long journey with a happy arrival.
pacing: One stop on the timeline at a time, slowing down at prison, speeding up to freedom.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own timeline of Mandela's life.
